For a long time, weekly objectives felt banished to obscurity. You had to hunt them down in the right panel. You had to remember to manually linked them to your tasks. They were easily forgotten once you got into the week.


Weekly objectives now have the gravitas they deserve, as your guiding star through all the noise of the week.


New standalone "This week" page


Get a big-picture view of your week from the new "This week" page. Define what your objectives are for this week, and map out the tasks that must be done to accomplish them.


New "This week's objectives" miniview as part of "Today"


Keep your weekly objectives top of mind as you work through your day, with the new miniview in the "Today" view.


The miniview shows you which weekly objectives you are making progress towards today. If none are lit up, it's a reminder that you might have gotten lost in the weeds of low-priority work.


Automatic linking of tasks to objectives


When there is a clear match between a task you create, and your objectives for the week, that task is automatically linked to the objective. Similar to how channels and planned time are automatically suggested, but with a higher confidence bar, so false positives should be rare.
